name: Dr. Elena Vasquez
bio: Founder & CEO of Fieldnote AI, launched 4 months ago. Former head of applied ML at a Fortune 500 logistics company. Published 2 peer-reviewed papers on multi-agent systems, cited 300+ times. Regular keynote speaker at AI conferences.
pitch_text: I'd love to come on the show to talk about what it actually takes to deploy multi-agent AI systems in production logistics - not the hype, the real failure modes we hit in the first 90 days. Happy to bring specific war stories and numbers.
